mapper.select: SELECT /* homes.stuff.mapper.StuffMapper.selectBrkStuffList 중개사 물건 목록 */ STF.STUFFNO, STF.BRKNO, STF.HTBDNO , STF.HPPSCD , HPS.CODE_NM AS HPPSNM , DATE_FORMAT(STF.CREAT_DT, '%Y.%m.%d') AS CRDE , MST.ARCD, MST.LEGCD, MST.BDADDR , MST.PPSCD , PPS.PPS_NM , MST.BULDNM, MST.HSHLDCO, MST.FMLYCO, MST.BULDCO , HPS.FILLER_V1 AS BGCOLOR FROM TB_BRK_BULD_STUFF STF INNER JOIN TB_HBD_LEDGR_MSTR MST ON STF.HTBDNO = MST.HTBDNO INNER JOIN TB_CM_COMMCODE HPS ON HPS.MXTR_COMM_CD = STF.HPPSCD INNER JOIN TB_CM_REGSTR_PPSCODE PPS ON MST.PPSCD = PPS.PPS_CD WHERE OFFICENO = #{officeno}

SELECT /* homes.stuff.mapper.StuffMapper.selectBrkBlockList 단지내 포함된 동명조회 */ STF.STUFFNO , STF.HTBDNO , LGR.HBDNO , LGR.BULDGB , LGR.BULDNM , LGR.DONGNM , CASE WHEN INSTR(LGR.DONGNM, '동') = 0 THEN 999999999999 ELSE CONVERT(SUBSTR(LGR.DONGNM, 1, INSTR(LGR.DONGNM, '동') -1), UNSIGNED) END AS DONGNO FROM TB_BRK_BULD_STUFF STF INNER JOIN TB_HBD_LEDGR LGR ON STF.HTBDNO = LGR.HTBDNO WHERE STF.HTBDNO = #{htbdno} AND OFFICENO = #{officeno} ORDER BY DONGNM ASC

SELECT /* homes.stuff.mapper.StuffMapper.selectFloorCount 동별 총 층수, 총 호실 수 조회 */ BULDNO , MAX(FLNO) AS FLOOR_CO , MAX(RMCO) AS ROOM_CO FROM ( SELECT UPPER_REGSTR_PK AS BULDNO , FLOOR_GB_CD AS FLGBCD , FLOOR_NO AS FLNO , COUNT(1) AS RMCO FROM TB_HBD_PSSION_BULD WHERE UPPER_REGSTR_PK = #{buldno} AND FLOOR_GB_CD = #{flgbcd} GROUP BY UPPER_REGSTR_PK, FLOOR_GB_CD, FLOOR_NO ) A GROUP BY BULDNO

WITH RECURSIVE TB_MAX_FLOOR AS ( SELECT 1 AS RN UNION ALL SELECT RN + 1 FROM TB_MAX_FLOOR WHERE RN < FN_GET_MAX_FLOOR( #{hbdno}, #{flgbcd}) ) , TB_FLOOR AS ( SELECT NVL(FLR.HBDNO , #{hbdno}) AS HBDNO , NVL(FLR.FLGBCD, #{flgbcd}) AS FLGBCD , MXF.RN AS RN , NVL(FLR.FLNO , 0) AS FLNO FROM TB_MAX_FLOOR MXF LEFT JOIN ( SELECT FLR.HTBDNO, FLR.HBDNO , FLR.FLGBCD, FLR.FLNO FROM TB_HBD_LEDGR_FLOOR FLR WHERE FLR.HBDNO = #{hbdno} AND FLR.FLGBCD = #{flgbcd} ) FLR ON MXF.RN = FLR.FLNO ) , TB_ROOM AS ( SELECT PSN.HBDNO, PSN.FLNO , GROUP_CONCAT(PSN.HPSNO ORDER BY HPSNO SEPARATOR '|') AS HPSNOS , GROUP_CONCAT(PSN.HOSILNM ORDER BY HOSILNM SEPARATOR '|') AS HOSILNMS FROM TB_HBD_LEDGR_PSSION_AREA PSN WHERE PSN.HBDNO = #{hbdno} AND PSN.FLGBCD = #{flgbcd} GROUP BY PSN.HBDNO, PSN.FLNO ORDER BY PSN.HPSNO ASC ) , TB_MAX_ROOM AS ( SELECT PSN.HBDNO , 1 AS MIN_ROOMCO , MAX(ROOMCO) AS MAX_ROOMCO FROM ( SELECT PSN.HBDNO, PSN.FLNO , COUNT(1) AS ROOMCO FROM TB_HBD_LEDGR_PSSION_AREA PSN WHERE PSN.HBDNO = #{hbdno} AND PSN.FLGBCD = #{flgbcd} GROUP BY PSN.HBDNO, PSN.FLNO ) PSN GROUP BY PSN.HBDNO ) SELECT FL.HBDNO, FL.FLGBCD, FL.RN , NVL(RM.HPSNOS , 'EMPTY') AS HPSNOS , NVL(RM.HOSILNMS, 'EMPTY') AS HOSILNMS , NVL(MR.MIN_ROOMCO, 0) AS MIN_ROOM_CO , NVL(MR.MAX_ROOMCO, 0) AS MAX_ROOM_CO FROM TB_FLOOR FL LEFT JOIN TB_ROOM RM ON FL.FLNO = RM.FLNO LEFT JOIN TB_MAX_ROOM MR ON FL.HBDNO = MR.HBDNO
ORDER BY FL.RN ASC
ORDER BY FL.RN DESC
ORDER BY FL.RN ASC

SELECT /* homes.stuff.mapper.StuffMapper.selectStuffOwnerList 중개사 물건 소유주 목록조회 */ A.STUFFNO AS STUFFNO , A.BULDNO AS BULDNO , A.CPLXNO AS CPLXNO , A.PSSIONNO AS PSSIONNO , B.FLOOR_GB_CD AS FLGBCD , B.FLOOR_GB_NM AS FLGBNM , B.DONG_NM AS DONGNM , B.FLOOR_NO AS FLNO , B.HO_NM AS ROOMNM , C.BRKNO AS BRKNO , D.OWNO AS OWNO , D.OWSEQ AS OWSEQ , D.USERNO AS USERNO , D.STFFNM01 AS STFFNM01 , D.STFFNM02 AS STFFNM02 , D.OWNER_TY AS OWNER_TY , D.OWNERNM AS OWNERNM , D.CCB_CD AS CCB_CD , D.CTTPC AS CTTPC , C.SFSTTUS AS SFSTTUS , D.OWSTTUS AS OWSTTUS FROM TB_HBD_BULD_STUFF A LEFT JOIN TB_HBD_PSSION_BULD B ON ( A.BULDNO = B.BULD_REGSTR_PK AND A.PSSIONNO = B.UPPER_REGSTR_PK ) LEFT JOIN TB_BRK_BULD_STUFF C ON ( A.STUFFNO = C.STUFFNO ) LEFT JOIN TB_BRK_BULD_OWNER D ON ( A.STUFFNO = D.STUFFNO AND C.BRKNO = D.BRKNO ) WHERE A.BULDNO = #{buldno} AND C.BRKNO = #{brkno}
SELECT /* homes.stuff.mapper.StuffMapper.selectStuffPPscd 부동산 용도코드 조회 */ PPS_CD, PPS_NM , PPS_CD_01 , PPS_NM_01 , PPS_CD_02, PPS_NM_02 , PPS_CD_03, PPS_NM_03 FROM VW_PPS_CD WHERE PPS_CD_03 = #{ppscd}
SELECT /* homes.stuff.mapper.StuffMapper.createStuffno 물건번호 신규채번 */ CONCAT('SF', LPAD(NVL(MAX(REPLACE(STUFFNO, 'SF', '')), 0) + 1, 20, '0')) AS STUFFNO FROM TB_HBD_BULD_STUFF
SELECT /* homes.stuff.mapper.StuffMapper.createOwno 소유주번호 신규채번 */ CONCAT('OW', LPAD(NVL(MAX(REPLACE(OWNO, 'OW', '')), 0) + 1, 20, '0')) AS STUFFNO FROM TB_BRK_BULD_OWNER

SELECT /* homes.stuff.mapper.StuffMapper.selectBrkStuff 중개사 물건목록조회 */ A.STUFFNO, A.BULDNO, A.CPLXNO, A.PSSIONNO , B.BRKNO, B.SFSTTUS FROM TB_HBD_BULD_STUFF A INNER JOIN TB_BRK_BULD_STUFF B ON A.STUFFNO = B.STUFFNO WHERE B.BRKNO = #{brkno} AND A.BULDNO = #{buldno}

SELECT /* homes.stuff.mapper.StuffMapper.selectMasterbunji 대표지번 조회 */ ARCODE , CONCAT(ARNAME_1, ' ', ARNAME_2, ' ', ARNAME_3, ' ', NVL(ARNAME_4, ''), ' ') AS ARNAME , BUNJIB AS BUNJIB , '0000' AS BUNJIJ , RDCODE AS RDCODE , RD_MAIN_BUN AS RD_MAIN_BUN FROM TB_RD_RDMASTER_JIBUN WHERE ARCODE = #{arcode} AND BUNJIB = #{bun} AND RD_MAIN_BUN = #{rdmainb}

SELECT /* homes.stuff.mapper.StuffMapper.selectHbdRegstrMaster 홈즈_관리대장_총괄표제부 조회 */ A.HTBDNO, C.SHTBDNO, A.BULDGB, A.ARCD, A.LEGCD, A.BUNJIB, A.BUNJIJ , A.BULDNM, A.BDADDR, A.RDADDR , A.BULD_REGSTR_PK , A.PPSCD, A.PPSETCNM, A.ESTCD , A.HSHLDCO, A.FMLYCO, A.BULDCO, A.BULDSUBCO, A.HOSILCO, A.PARKNGCO , A.RDCODE, A.RDLEGCD, A.UNDER_AT , A.TOTAL_AR, A.SUPPLY_AR, A.PLAT_AR, A.BULD_AR, A.BULK_CALC_TOT_AR , A.BULD_LND_RT, A.BULK_RT, A.CRDE , B.CODE_NM AS ESTNM , A.RD_MAIN_BUN AS RDMBUN , A.RD_SUB_BUN AS RDSBUN , ( SELECT AR_FULL_NM FROM TB_CM_COAREACODE AR WHERE AR.ARCODE = A.ARCD AND AR.LEGCODE = A.LEGCD ) AS ARNAME , ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_HBD_LEDGR B WHERE A.HTBDNO = B.HTBDNO ) AS BULDCO , ( SELECT MAX(GRNDCO) FROM TB_HBD_LEDGR B WHERE A.HTBDNO = B.HTBDNO ) AS GRNDCO , ( SELECT MAX(UNDERCO) FROM TB_HBD_LEDGR B WHERE A.HTBDNO = B.HTBDNO ) AS UNDERCO FROM TB_HBD_LEDGR_MSTR A LEFT JOIN TB_CM_COMMCODE B ON A.ESTCD = B.MXTR_COMM_CD LEFT JOIN TB_HBD_LEDGR_MSTR_RELJIBUN C ON A.HTBDNO = C.SHTBDNO WHERE A.ARCD = #{arcd} AND A.LEGCD = #{legcd} AND A.BUNJIB = #{bun} AND ( C.MBUNJIJ = #{ji} OR C.BUNJIJ = #{ji} ) AND A.USE_YN = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO /* homes.stuff.mapper.StuffMapper.insertHbdRegstrMaster 홈즈_관리대장_총괄표제부 등록 */ TB_HBD_LEDGR_MASTER ( HTBDNO, BULDGB, ARCD, LEGCD, BUNJIB, BUNJIJ, BULDNM, BULD_REGSTR_PK, BDADDR, RDADDR, PPSCD, PPSETCNM, HSHLDCO, FMLYCO, BULDCO, BULDSUBCO, ROOMCO, PARKNGCO, PLATGB, RDCODE, RDLEGCD, UNDER_AT, RD_MAIN_BUN, RD_SUB_BUN, TOTAL_AR, SUPPLY_AR, PLAT_AR, BULD_AR, BULK_CALC_AR, BULD_LND_RT, BULK_RT, CRDE, USE_YN, BATCH_YN, CREAT_USER_NO, UPDT_USER_NO ) VALUES ( #{htbdno}, #{buldgb}, #{arcd}, #{legcd}, #{bunjib}, #{bunjij}, #{buldnm}, #{buldRegstrPk}, #{bdaddr}, #{rdaddr}, #{ppscd}, #{ppsetcnm}, #{hshldco}, #{fmlyco}, #{buldco}, #{buldsubco}, #{roomco}, #{parkngco}, #{platgb}, #{rdcode}, #{rdlegcd}, #{underAt}, #{rdMainBun}, #{rdSubBun}, #{totalAr}, #{supplyAr}, #{platAr}, #{buldAr}, #{bulkCalcAr}, #{buldLndRt}, #{bulkRt}, #{crde}, #{useYn}, #{batchYn}, #{brkno}, #{brkno} )

INSERT INTO /* homes.stuff.mapper.StuffMapper.insertHbdLedgr 홈즈_관리대장_표제부 등록 */ TB_HBD_LEDGR ( BULDNO, HTBDNO, BULD_REGSTR_PK , BULDGB, ARCD, LEGCD, BUNJIB, BUNJIJ, BULDNM , BDADDR, RDADDR, PPSCD, PPSETCNM , CFMVGB, CNFMDE, MOVEINDE, RIDE_ELVTCO, EMGR_ELVTCO, FLGROUND, FLUNDER , HSHLDCO, FMLYCO, PLATGB, RDCODE, RDLEGCD, UNDER_AT , RD_MAIN_BUN, RD_SUB_BUN , TOTAL_AR, SUPPLY_AR, PLAT_AR, BULD_AR, CRDE , USE_YN, BATCH_YN, CREAT_USER_NO, UPDT_USER_NO ) VALUES ( #{buldno}, #{htbdno}, #{bregstrPk}, #{buldgb}, #{arcd}, #{legcd}, #{bunjib}, #{bunjij}, #{buldnm}, #{bdaddr}, #{rdaddr}, #{ppscd}, #{ppsetcnm}, #{cfmvgb}, #{confde}, #{moveinde}, #{rideElvtrco}, #{emgrElvtrco}, #{flgroundco}, #{flunderco}, #{hshldco}, #{fmlyco}, #{platgb}, #{rdcode}, #{rdlegcd}, #{underAt}, #{rdMainBun}, #{rdSubBun}, #{totalAr}, #{supplyAr}, #{platAr}, #{buldAr}, #{crde}, #{useYn}, #{batchYn}, #{brkno}, #{brkno} )
mapper.update: UPDATE /* homes.stuff.mapper.StuffMapper.deleteBrkOwner 소유주 삭제 */ TB_BRK_BULD_OWNER SET USERNO = 0 , OWNER_TY = '' , OWNERNM = '' , CCB_CD = '' , CTTPC = '' , CNTC_PERSN_YN = 'N' , OWSTTUS = 'T' , UPDT_USER_NO = #{brkno} , UPDT_DT = NOW() WHERE OWNO = #{owno} AND OWSEQ = #{owseq} AND BRKNO = #{brkno}
